newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Riddell Sports Q2 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Riddell Sports Q2 loss vs profit.

text.p: (Dollars in thousands except per share data)
NOTE: The company said results were not comparable to the prior-year periods because of its recent acquisition of Varsity Spirit Corp.
Said its results for the second quarter and six months of 1997 include about two weeks of Varsity results, from the acquisition date to the end of the second quarter.

Net income for the second quarter and the first six months of 1997 include a $3.0 million charge to interest expense for costs of a related bridge loan commitment, and $1.1 million for the quarter and $2.6 million for the six months for an increased level of legal expenses relating to recently settled fraudulent conveyance litigation and related cases.
Net income for the second quarter at Varsity included charges related to the acquisition and other adjustments of $8.5 million, which resulted in a loss of $3.8 million before interest and taxes.
